tools.name: describe_article
tools.description: What one piece of writing actually covers — its section headings in order, opening paragraph, length and reading time — without pulling the full text. Use this to decide whether an article is worth reading in full. Accepts a slug from list_writing (e.g. 'saut' or 'saut/three-hats') or the title.

article.description: Article slug or title, e.g. 'godrej' or 'saut/three-hats'.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: The complete text of one case study or essay, as markdown-style prose with its headings. Use when you need to quote it or answer detail questions; prefer describe_article first if you only need to know what it covers.

article.description: Article slug or title, e.g. 'mivi' or 'saut/worksheet-builder'.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: How to get in touch with Isaac — email, social links and current availability for work.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Who Isaac Solomon is: role, availability, location, background, the services he takes on and the clients he's built for. Start here when asked a general question about him.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Full detail for one project, including its live URL and case study link. Accepts the project title or its slug (from list_projects).

project.description: Project title or slug, e.g. "Mivi" or "saut".

tools.name: inspect_image_c2pa
tools.description: Fetch a single image (by CSS selector or URL) and return its fully decoded C2PA manifest store: every manifest's claim, assertions (e.g. c2pa.actions edit history, schema.org authorship), and the COSE signature details (algorithm and signing-certificate identity). Provide exactly one of `selector` or `url`. Note: the signature is decoded but NOT cryptographically verified.

selector.description: CSS selector for an element on the page.

url.description: Image URL (absolute, or relative to the current page) to fetch and inspect.

tools.name: list_photos
tools.description: Isaac's photography — each frame with its title, location, description and image URL. Optionally filter by a free-text query matched against title, location and description.

query.description: Filter by place, location or description, e.g. 'Kedarkantha' or 'stars'.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List portfolio projects with year, category, tags and a summary. Optionally filter by a free-text query matched against title, category and tags.

query.description: Filter by title, category or tag, e.g. "e-commerce".

tools.name: list_writing
tools.description: List the case studies and essays, with reading time and year. Optionally filter by a free-text query.

query.description: Filter by title, description or tag.

tools.name: scan_images_c2pa
tools.description: Scan every on the current page for C2PA Content Credentials (content provenance metadata) and return a per-image summary: whether a manifest is present, the claim generator (the tool that produced or edited the image), the title, and the signer name. Use this to find which images on a page carry provenance data. Note: provenance is decoded but NOT cryptographically verified.

limit.description: Maximum number of images to fetch and scan (default 25, max 100).

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Free-text search across projects, writing, services and work history. Use when you do not know which category an answer lives in.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "SvelteKit" or "RTL".
